objective: To get the crossdock customer orders for a Delivery Date and Rit and pre-map them to supplier POs ([Get Order], function X12).
To display the delivery plan per Part Number + Customer Order Date at case level (Case Qty, PO Readiness, ASN Status Ready / Not Ready / Created).
To let the D/S team see the destination and order line detail and hold / release customer order lines.
To select one or more Ready units, map them to their POs, review the cases, download the case labels and submit the ASN.

screen_mode_remarks: 1) The check box of a unit is enabled only when its ASN Status is Ready (message no. 1 or 2 as tooltip otherwise).
2) Units of different Customer Order Dates and Part Numbers can be ticked together; each unit always goes into the ASN as a whole.
3) The expand buttons and Hold / Release are shown to the D/S team only; the supplier sees the header (case level) only.
4) Get Order is enabled when Delivery Date is filled and a Rit is available (message no. 5 otherwise).

items: On first display Delivery Date = business date + 1, Rit = first rit of the date, Route displayed (disabled). The delivery plan is empty.

[Get Order] runs the function X12 (UISS X12): customer orders of H0253 with order status 7, Hold Flag N, not mapped, earliest order date first per part number (FIFO), pre-mapped to the PO parts of the Pra Daily Order (FIFO PO date) in the temporary table #TB_R_INSTRUCTION.

The delivery plan shows one row per Part Number + Customer Order Date, sorted Ready, Not Ready, Created, then Part Number ascending. Part Number and Status filters apply at once. No row: message no. 3.
Delivery Date and Rit do not filter the orders; they are carried to the ASN.
Unit = Part Number + Customer Order Date. Case = one per destination; the qty of a destination is summed into one case (it never exceeds pcs/case, it may be split over several lines, e.g. 4 + 2).
Case Qty = number of destinations. PO Readiness (case) = cases whose whole qty is pre-mapped to a PO.

Ready ('6'): every line of the unit is pre-mapped to a PO. Not Ready ('7'): at least one line of the unit has no PO yet (check box disabled, message no. 2). With POs of different PO Dates the unit becomes Ready when the last PO is available (condition 3).
Created: the unit is in a submitted ASN (ASN status '1'); ticked and locked (message no. 1).

The D/S team can expand a unit (destinations with Case, Qty, Not Assigned pcs) and a destination (original order lines with Customer Order No, Detailed Item No, Qty, PO No, PO Date, Assignment). The supplier sees the header only.

Hold / Release updates HOLD_FLAG of the line in TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE (refer Data Edit Mapping). A held line is not taken by Get Order; the unit is computed without it. A unit whose lines are all on hold is shown as On Hold to the D/S team only.
HOLD_FLAG is 'N' when the line is first replicated (X10) and is kept on the next replications.
The user ticks one or more Ready units, also of different Customer Order Dates and Part Numbers. A unit is never split.

[Create ASN] does the real mapping of the selected units in one transaction: PO_MAPPED_FLAG = 'Y' on their H0253 lines, mapped qty on the Pra Daily Order parts, and the ASN draft in #TEMP_ASN_DRAFT (one case per Part Number + Customer Order Date + destination). Then the Case List opens.
If a unit is no longer Ready (changed by another user), the creation is rejected (message no. 7) and the delivery plan is refreshed.
[Back] / [Cancel] on the Case List release the mapping (flags and mapped qty back) and clear the draft.
The summary shows ASN No (assigned on submit), supplier, Delivery Date · Rit · Route of the Get Order, Delivery Qty (pcs) and number of cases.
Each case shows Case Number, Part Number and Qty; the expand shows PO No, Manifest No, Manifest Item No and PO Qty. Customer order data is not shown here.
[Download Case Label]: TBD (format, file name, content).

[Submit ASN]: confirmation (message no. 4). Yes: insert TB_R_ASN_CROSSDOCK_H with ASN_STATUS '1' Created and TB_R_ASN_CROSSDOCK_D from the draft; ASN No and Case No follow the existing numbering (last sequence table). Display message no. 6; the units show Created.
#TB_R_INSTRUCTION and #TEMP_ASN_DRAFT are temporary tables. Submitted ASNs are shown in ASN Inquiry (X13).
The prototype has a 'Business date' switch (PO release) and a 'View as' switch (Supplier / D/S team); they are not part of the real screen.

tables.name: #TB_R_INSTRUCTION
tables.description: Temporary table of one Get Order run (session): customer order line (H0253, order status 7, Hold Flag N, not mapped) pre-mapped to a supplier PO (Pra Daily Order), FIFO by order date. One row per line x PO, plus one row with PO_NO NULL for the qty still without a PO. Columns proposed.
